name: @semantius/example-spa-hono-backend
description: Decoupled resource-server counterpart to the Next.js sample: a standalone Hono API (Node) that validates/forwards a bearer token, opens a request-scoped transaction, injects claims, and runs RLS-enforced Drizzle queries. Vendors the SAME lib/db layer as examples/nextjs. One flag (DB_AUTH_MODE = bearer | session) runs it unchanged against local PG18 OAUTHBEARER, Neon, and Supabase.
